name: get_services
description:
Search NASA CMR services for a specific parent collection and return up to 20 UMM-S records.

Key UMM-S fields in each returned item:
- meta.concept-id: CMR service concept ID
- umm.Name: service name
- umm.Type: service type (e.g., OPeNDAP, WCS, Harmony, WMS, WMTS, ESI, EGI - No Processing)
- umm.Version: service version string
- umm.Description: human-readable service description
- umm.OnlineResource: URL, link name, and description for the service endpoint
- umm.ServiceOptions: supported output formats, projections, subset types, and interpolation methods
- umm.OperationMetadata: operation names (e.g., GetCapabilities, GetMap) and distributed computing platform
- umm.MetadataSpecification: schema metadata (URL, Name, Version)

Specification reference:
- Use umm.MetadataSpecification.URL from each returned item for the exact schema URL.
- Earthdata hosts UMM-S schemas under https://cdn.earthdata.nasa.gov/umm/service/.

Key parameters:
- collection_concept_id: required parent collection concept ID

Iteration & Refinement:
- Results are strictly capped at 20 items to optimize context window usage.
- If total_hits exceeds 20, you have received the first 20 services. Paging is not supported.

Note: A collection may be associated with multiple services of different types. Check umm.Type to distinguish between data access services (e.g., OPeNDAP, WCS) and discovery/visualization services (e.g., WMS, WMTS).
